freeze_rule: Freeze the first candidate for which every quadadd positional-encoding/seed cell has train exact match at least 0.8.
futility_amendment_after_c1_nope_seed0: Candidate c1 produced 0.184 exact match in its first required cell, below the 0.8 threshold. Because selection is an all-cell conjunction, that candidate can no longer pass. Subsequent candidates therefore stop at the first failed required cell. This cannot change candidate acceptance or the first-passing selection; it only skips cells whose outcomes are logically irrelevant. No intervention outcome was inspected.
runtime_resume_after_c2_nope_seed0: The first runtime reached its maximum duration after c1 NoPE seed 0 scored 0.184 and c2 NoPE seed 0 scored 0.178, and just after c3 training began. Both candidates are irrevocably rejected by the frozen all-cell threshold. The search resumes at c3 on a fresh runtime; no rejected candidate is retrained and no causal outcome has been inspected.

confirmatory_run.primary_contrast: source_max minus distractor_control exact match at length 250
confirmatory_run.success_rule: All arities retain train exact match at least 0.8 and have a positive hierarchical 95% interval for the primary contrast.

failure_rule: If no candidate clears competence, report the arity experiment as capacity-limited and do not interpret its causal contrast.
